'''2001 New Jersey State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in New Jersey in 2001. [[Michael Dalton]] won it.<ref name="dt-16095">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/16095 Dalton's Hidden Mains], DeckTech (Michael "faramir" L. Dalton, 21 May 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/16095/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/16095/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 20 May 2001<ref name="tr-d2335" />
* '''Site:''' New Jersey; Cedar Grove, New Jersey<ref name="tr-d2335" />
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Dalton]]
* '''Players:''' 28<ref name="tr-d2358" />

The event is known from players' DeckTech posts; they give no exact date. It was played before the [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] expansion was released on 30 May 2001.

Dalton won with a Hidden Base mains deck. His posted list is an improved version: since States he took out Obi-Wan's Lightsaber, two Ben Kenobi and the Tatooine docking bay, and put in a second Luke's Lightsaber, two more EPP Obi-Wans and the Endor docking bay.<ref name="dt-16095" />
